title: Tennessee Whiskey
subtitle: Tennessee whiskey and Nearest Green
description: How Tennessee whiskey is made, and Nearest Green, the enslaved distiller who taught Jack Daniel. Four pours.

pours.name: Jack Daniel’s Old No. 7
pours.notes: Before anything else, notice the weight of it in your mouth. The charcoal is meant to make it lighter.

pours.name: George Dickel Signature Recipe
pours.notes: The same process at another distillery. Compare it with the Jack Daniel’s for sweetness and weight.

pours.name: Buffalo Trace
pours.notes: A Kentucky bourbon with no charcoal step. Taste it beside the Dickel, which is the same proof.

pours.name: Jack Daniel’s Bonded
pours.notes: Jack Daniel’s again, this time at 100 proof. Compare it with the first pour, then try it with a few drops of water.
